evidence.observation: During multi-engine route run, 24 Ollama calls returned LocalSummaryError and 24 returned URLError WinError 10061 connection refused.
curl /api/version and /api/tags returned http=000; tasklist showed no ollama.exe; netstat showed no listener on 11434.

Restart of <USERPROFILE>/AppData/Local/Programs/Ollama/ollama.exe serve logged version 0.40.18, OLLAMA_MODELS=<USERPROFILE>\.ollama\models, total blobs 0, cloud hydration timeout to ollama.com, and warning about incompatible ggml-base.dll from llama.cpp WinGet path.
HTTP requests hung (http=000) while process remained running.

Restart with OLLAMA_NO_CLOUD=1 and OLLAMA_MODELS=E:/OLLAMA_MODELS restored service; /api/tags then listed qwen3.5-defiant-uncensored:latest, gemma3:4b, phi4-mini:latest instead of earlier qwen3.5:4b-q4_K_M and qwen2.5:1.5b.

conclusion: The transient failure was reproduced as service/store/network configuration drift, not a model inference defect. Earlier malformed done=false responses remain separately recorded and are not fully explained.
